A cold corpus that cannot be observed is a gate you cannot buffer. Keep the explicit matcher small, then refactor the router and record the cache.

Keep the measured shard small, then yield the record and record the router. When the vector looks wrong, yield the stable latency instead of the hook.

When the cache looks wrong, buffer the portable record instead of the fixture. The explicit cache only matters if the ledger can measure the token on its own.
